title.value: An Empirical Study of Data Access Self-Admitted Technical Debt
title.justification: The title clearly reflects the main focus of the paper, which is an empirical study of self-admitted technical debt in data access, as specified in the abstract and content of the paper.
title.quote: We present a large-scale empirical study on the prevalence, composition, and evolution of SATD in data-intensive systems.

extractions.description: This paper investigates self-admitted technical debt (SATD) in data-intensive systems with a focus on data access logic. It conducts a large-scale empirical study analyzing the prevalence, composition, and evolution of SATDs in systems using relational and NoSQL databases. The paper introduces a taxonomy for SATD categories specific to data access and examines the introduction and removal circumstances of such debt.

primary_category.justification: The paper addresses software development technical debt which doesn't fit directly into any predefined eco-responsible categories. It focuses on software quality and technical debt management, areas not covered by our environmental categories.
primary_category.quote: We conduct an empirical study to understand the prevalence and persistence of SATDs, their composition, and the circumstances of their introduction and removal.

secondary_categories.justification: The study is focused on software engineering issues not directly related to eco-responsible AI use cases or environmental sustainability.
secondary_categories.quote: We focus on data-accesses and define data-access SATDs as SATDs that occur in data-access classes, i.e., classes with direct database interactions or other persistence systems via calls to driver functions or APIs.

primary_sub_category.justification: The sub-categories provided do not cover software engineering, technical debt, or software quality, under which this study's findings fall.
primary_sub_category.quote: Our results show that data-access SATDs have lower survival than regular SATDs...

secondary_sub_categories.justification: Software engineering and technical debt management are not covered by the current sub-categories, which focus on environmental and sustainability topics.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: We identified 15 new SATD categories, out of which 11 are specific to database access operations.

new_primary_category.value: Software Quality and Technical Debt Management
new_primary_category.justification: The entire study is centered around understanding and managing technical debt, particularly self-admitted technical debt in data-intensive software systems.
new_primary_category.quote: We identified 15 new SATD categories, out of which 11 are specific to database access operations... highlight the importance of research work in SATDs ... providing processes and frameworks for monitoring technical debt.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The study specifically focuses on technical debt within the data access component of data-intensive systems, identifying unique categories and proposing management strategies.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: We conduct an empirical study to understand the prevalence and persistence of SATDs, their composition, and the circumstances of their introduction and removal... ...data-access SATDs because mismanagement of SATDs in such classes can significantly impact the overall quality of a data-intensive system.
